# h3_backup (Resource)

Manages an off-site backup of an `h3_snapshot` (copied to the separate backup storage). Apply waits until the upload is `READY` (up to 60 minutes). Every argument change creates a new backup. Import with `<project_id>/<backup_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Off-site copy of a snapshot in the separate backup storage.
resource "h3_backup" "weekly" {
  project_id  = var.project_id
  snapshot_id = h3_snapshot.before_upgrade.id
  name        = "weekly"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Backup name
- `snapshot_id` (String) ID of the snapshot to back up (must be `READY`)

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) Project ID (UUID). Defaults to the provider `project_id` (`H3_PROJECT_ID`). Changing it replaces the backup.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp
- `disk_id` (String) Source disk ID, when reported by the API
- `id` (String) Backup ID
- `size` (String) Backup size
- `status` (String) Backup status (`PENDING`, `UPLOADING`, `READY`, `FAILED`)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project_id>/<backup_id>
terraform import h3_backup.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/<backup_id>
```
